entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: An idyllic world of perpetual midsummer where races of fable live together in harmony; it transforms into Shadowmoor every three centuries.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark mirror-image of Lorwyn, in perpetual dusk and gloom, whose races are transformed into darker versions of themselves.

entities.name: The Elves of Lorwyn
entities.description: Lorwyn's most favored and feared race, who consider themselves paragons of beauty; in Shadowmoor they are humbled and heroic.

entities.name: The Flamekin
entities.description: Hot-tempered, transcendence-seeking people of Lorwyn who become smoking skeletons seeking revenge in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: The Faeries
entities.description: The only race unchanged by the transformation, who dwell in Glen Elendra and are the fulcrum of the transforming plane.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The home of the faeries, unchanged between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The queen of the faeries, who caused the plane's transformation.

events.summary: Every three centuries Lorwyn's cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor.
events.quote: every three centuries, that cycle transforms the plane into Shadowmoor.

events.summary: In Shadowmoor the plane's races, without memory of their previous selves, are transformed and locked in a struggle for survival.
events.quote: Here, the plane's races, without knowledge of their previous selves, are locked in a life-and-death struggle for survival.

events.summary: The flamekin become smoking skeletons seeking revenge while the vain elves become humbled and heroic.
events.quote: the flamekin are now smoking skeletons seeking revenge.

events.summary: Oona, queen of the faeries, causes the plane's transformation.
events.quote: for it was their queen, Oona, who caused it.

relations.quote: for it was their queen, Oona, who caused it.

relations.note: Their home, unchanged by the transformation.
relations.quote: the faeries and their home of Glen Elendra
The mirror-image of Lorwyn, Shadowmoor is a realm of perpetual dusk and gloom.
